title: Paul McCartney live: Kölnarena, Cologne | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Kölnarena in Cologne, Germany, on 28 April 2003.

It was the 17th date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003, and the second of two consecutive nights in Cologne.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Kölnarena on 16 and 17 December 2009 during the Good Evening Europe Tour, and 1 December 2011 for the On The Run Tour.
